metric: document-level chrF2 (sacreBLEU); per direction, per dataset (no cross-direction mean)

finance.name: Citizens' Budget
finance.description: Plain-language summary of Ghana's annual national budget, published by the Ministry of Finance in English and in several Ghanaian languages. The language editions are human translations of the English edition of the same year.
finance.format: PDF (some with broken or image-only text layers, so text is extracted page by page with Gemini vision)

udhr.name: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
udhr.description: Official human translations of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) across Ghanaian languages, evaluated at document/corpus level against the English reference charter.
udhr.format: XML / Plain text (structured paragraphs from the UN OHCHR & Unicode UDHR project)

jw.name: Watchtower (Study Edition)
jw.publisher: Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society
jw.description: Monthly study edition of The Watchtower, human-translated into Ghanaian languages and English. Full issues evaluated at document level.
jw.format: PDF (extracted page by page with Gemini vision)

folktales.name: Akan-Ashanti Folk-Tales
folktales.description: 75 Ashanti folk-tales printed in parallel: the Asante Twi original on the left-hand page and Rattray's English translation on the facing page. Each tale is one document pair, matched story to story (tales run across pages), scored at document level.
folktales.format: Scanned PDF (extracted page by page with Gemini vision, re-joined across page breaks and split into tales at their titles)
